_about: Page copy for each area page built from templates/area.html by scripts/build_pages.py. Data links live in registry.json. UBC is hand-built and not listed here.

point-grey.lede: Point Grey runs from the beaches at Jericho, Locarno and Spanish Banks up to the shops and cafés along West 10th. It's a mix of character homes, newer builds and low-rise condos, and it's a neighbourhood I've helped buyers and sellers in for years. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
point-grey.desc: Point Grey detached and apartment market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
point-grey.note: Point Grey has too few townhouse sales to chart reliably, so townhouses are not shown.
point-grey.ogdesc: Where Point Grey house and condo values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

dunbar.lede: Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights are two of the Westside's quieter family neighbourhoods, with Pacific Spirit Park on one side and the shops along Dunbar Street close by. This is mostly detached-home territory, so that's what we track here, with MacKenzie Heights shown on its own because it's a small pocket with its own price level. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
dunbar.desc: Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights detached home market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
dunbar.note: All figures are for detached homes. MacKenzie Heights is a small area with relatively few sales, so its numbers can move more from month to month.
dunbar.ogdesc: Where detached home values in Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.

kerrisdale.lede: Kerrisdale is my home turf. I live here, and my Engel & Völkers office is right in Kerrisdale Village on West 41st. The neighbourhood mixes big detached homes on leafy streets with apartments and townhouses close to the village shops, so we track all three. Here's where values are heading, how quickly homes are selling and how much room buyers have to negotiate, updated every month from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® data.
kerrisdale.desc: Kerrisdale detached, apartment and townhouse market statistics, updated monthly: benchmark prices, market balance, days to sell and sale-to-list prices. From Eric Coulombe, Engel & Völkers Vancouver.
kerrisdale.ogdesc: Where Kerrisdale house, condo and townhouse values are heading, how fast homes are selling, and how much room buyers have to negotiate.
